checks: Complete requires two valid times without inferring shift duration
A missing checkout marks an open record
An empty checkout is also open
An invalid checkout is unknown rather than a finished shift
Missing checkin remains unknown even with checkout
Invalid time is not displayed as recorded
Latest valid calendar dates sort first; same-day source order is stable
Search finds source location case-insensitively and trims input
Status, date and store filters combine
No matching store produces an empty list
Unknown status remains visible in its own filter
Unknown date is searchable without inventing a calendar date
Summary counts only the supplied result set
Filtering never mutates records or creates replacements
scope: Production pure helper executed with synthetic test records, not real employee attendance or backend.
